newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Plutonic says to halt Bellevue mine.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Plutonic says to halt Bellevue mine.

text.p: Plutonic Resources Ltd said on Friday its Bellevue gold project in Western Australia would be placed on care and maintenance over the next six weeks as all economic open pit and underground reserves will be depleted by April 30.
Bellevue, which was acquired in 1993, is the smallest of Plutonic's six mining operations in Western Australia,
Since discovery in 1896 the mine has produced in excess of 750,000 ounces with most of these ounces being produced since the mine was re-opened in 1987, Plutonic said.
In 1996 the mine, which is located 35 kms north-west of the nickel mining region of Leinster, produced 17,313 high cost ounces of gold from open pit and underground deposits, Plutonic said.
Mining at the small Vanguard pit finished March 13 and mining at the Henderson Pit will finish in early April, the company said.
Underground mining will continue only to April 30 with the objective of extracting ore already developed, it added.
"With cessation of open pit mining there will be insufficient production relative to fixed overheads to justify continuance of underground development and mining," the company said.
